paragraphs.text:
CONFERENCE 1. FIRST CONFERENCE OF ABBOT MOSES.
CONFERENCE 2. SECOND CONFERENCE OF ABBOT MOSES.
CONFERENCE 3. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT PAPHNUTIUS. ON THE THREE SORTS OF RENUNCIATIONS.
CONFERENCE 4. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT DANIEL. ON THE LUST OF THE FLESH AND OF THE SPIRIT.
CONFERENCE 5. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT SERAPION. ON THE EIGHT PRINCIPAL FAULTS.
CONFERENCE 6. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT THEODORE. ON THE DEATH OF THE SAINTS.
CONFERENCE 7. FIRST CONFERENCE OF ABBOT SERENUS. ON INCONSTANCY OF MIND, AND SPIRITUAL WICKEDNESS.
CONFERENCE 8. SECOND CONFERENCE OF ABBOT SERENUS. ON PRINCIPALITIES.
CONFERENCE 9. FIRST CONFERENCE OF ABBOT ISAAC. ON PRAYER.
CONFERENCE 10. SECOND CONFERENCE OF ABBOT ISAAC. ON PRAYER.
CONFERENCE 11. FIRST CONFERENCE OF ABBOT CHAEREMON. ON PERFECTION.
CONFERENCE 13. THIRD CONFERENCE OF ABBOT CHAEREMON. ON THE PROTECTION OF GOD.
CONFERENCE 14. FIRST CONFERENCE OF ABBOT NESTEROS. ON SPIRITUAL KNOWLEDGE.
CONFERENCE 15. SECOND CONFERENCE OF ABBOT NESTEROS. ON DIVINE GIFTS.
CONFERENCE 16. FIRST CONFERENCE OF ABBOT JOSEPH. ON FRIENDSHIP.
CONFERENCE 17. SECOND CONFERENCE OF ABBOT JOSEPH. ON MAKING PROMISES.
CONFERENCE 18. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT PIAMUN. ON THE THREE SORTS OF MONKS.
CONFERENCE 19. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT JOHN. ON THE AIM OF THE COENOBITE AND HERMIT.
CONFERENCE 20. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT PINUFIUS. ON THE END OF PENITENCE AND THE MARKS OF SATISFACTION.
CONFERENCE 21. FIRST CONFERENCE OF ABBOT THEONAS. ON THE RELAXATION DURING THE FIFTY DAYS.
CONFERENCE 23. THIRD CONFERENCE OF ABBOT THEONAS. ON SINLESSNESS.
CONFERENCE 24. CONFERENCE OF ABBOT ABRAHAM. ON MORTIFICATION.
